text: Ro-to-to-to-to... ♪

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_01
text: This is Clavell. Do I have the pleasure of\nspeaking with M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_select_01
text: Hi, Director Clavell!

label: sdc02_0000_select_02
text: Yep, that’s me!

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_02
text: My, my. It certainly does this old heart good to\nbe greeted with such a lively response![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_03
text: Now, if I could take but a moment of your time,\nthere is something we must discuss.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...you’re about
to
be
presented
with
an
exceptional
opportunity.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_06
text: You already know of the Unova region’s\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Academy[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], I presume?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_select_03
text: Of course!

label: sdc02_0000_select_04
text: What’s that?

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_07
text: Indeed. Tales of your school trip to Kitakami with\nthe Blueberry cohort reached even my office![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_08
text: Oh? Now this is a surprise. I’d heard you were\ntaking part in our joint trip with that fine school...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_09
text: In any case, the director of Blueberry Academy\nhappens to be an old friend of mine.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_10
text: And he told me that he would be delighted to\nhost you as an exchange student at his school.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_11
text:
I believe it would be a fine chance for you to
learn even more about the world.\c
One should always take advantage of new
challenges like this, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_12
text: Though I must confess—I was a bit surprised that\nBlueberry’s director would specify you by name...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_13
text: Still, I think it best that you meet the man at least\nonce to find out what he might be thinking.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_14
text: He is admittedly a bit of a character, but not to\nworry—I’ll be there with you when you meet him.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_15
text: Once you feel ready to respond to his offer, I ask\nthat you come by my office so we can discuss the\r\nspecifics together.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_17
text:
Ah! Do feel free to prioritize your ongoing school
trip, though, if you so wish.\c
This student exchange matter can wait a little
while.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0000_headteacher_16
text: Now, I won’t take up any more of your time.\nDo take care until we speak again.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
